WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(event_date) AS dt,
        event_date AS date,
        category,
        lower(page_name) AS page_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS err_sess
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 1 = 1
        AND {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     -- AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
     -- AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
        AND action = 'errorEvent'
        AND event_type = 'debug'
        AND error_type <> 'warning + confirmation'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
finabase AS (
    SELECT
        dt,
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,
        category,
        page_name,
        CASE
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%basket%'                  THEN 'Basket'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/account%'        THEN 'registration_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%'   THEN 'personalinfo_page'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/identification%' THEN 'ident_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/appointment%'    THEN 'appointment_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/payment%'        THEN 'payment_page'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%consent%'                 THEN 'orderreview_page'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS page_category,
        SUM(err_sess) AS err_sess
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
    HAVING
        CASE
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%basket%'                  THEN 'Basket'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/account%'        THEN 'registration_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%'   THEN 'personalinfo_page'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/identification%' THEN 'ident_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/appointment%'    THEN 'appointment_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/payment%'        THEN 'payment_page'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%consent%'                 THEN 'orderreview_page'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END <> 'Others'
)
SELECT
    period,
    category,
    SUM(err_sess) AS err_sess
FROM finabase
GROUP BY period_sort, period, category
ORDER BY period_sort;

    SELECT
        b.dt,
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'

            b.dt

        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(b.dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', b.dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),

        END AS period,
        b.identifiers_sessionid,
        b.identifiers_page_name,

        -- For consent page: don't count as exit if purchaseSuccess fired

        MAX(CASE WHEN b.next_page = 'exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        * CASE
            WHEN b.identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/consent'
             AND pf.identifiers_sessionid IS NOT NULL

)

    period,
    identifiers_page_name,

    SUM(exitedpage)                                                                     AS exiting_sessions,

* Personal Information: Continue clicked after completing personal information.

extracted_cards.sql:
-- Notes:
-- Removed LOWER from natco_code as there is no value in caps
-- Internalemployee filter is always 'no' in whole dataset so removing additional filter

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         DATE(event_date) AS dt
        ,event_date
        ,session_id
        ,service_line
        ,action
        ,label
        ,lower(page_name) AS page_name
        ,order_id
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
        [[AND {{customer_type}}]]
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     -- AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
     -- AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
        AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
),
base_flags AS (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        dt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name = 'basket'                        AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_basket,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout%'                 AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_checkout_open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/account%'        AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_registration,
        MAX(CASE WHEN action = 'loginSuccess'                                                                   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_login_success,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%'   AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_personalinfo,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name = 'checkout/personalinfo' AND action = 'clickInteractions' AND label = 'Weiter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_personalinfo_continue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/identification%' AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_ident,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name = 'checkout/identification' AND action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted'                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_ident_submitted,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/appointment%'    AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_appointment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name = 'checkout/appointment'  AND action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted'                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_appointment_submitted,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/shipping%'       AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_shipping,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name = 'checkout/shipping'     AND action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted'                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_shipping_submitted,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%checkout/payment%'        AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_payment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN page_name LIKE '%consent%'                 AND action = 'PageView'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_consent,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess'                                                          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_order_placed
    FROM base
    GROUP BY session_id, dt
),
base2 AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,

        -- Independent stage counts (pageview baselines)
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_basket = 1)         AS basket_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_registration = 1)   AS registration_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_personalinfo = 1)   AS personalinfo_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_ident = 1)          AS ident_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_appointment = 1)    AS appointment_page_optional,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_shipping = 1)       AS shipping_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_payment = 1)        AS payment_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_consent = 1)        AS orderreview_page,

        -- Closed funnel numerators: pageview + completion action, same session
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_basket = 1 and        f_checkout_open = 1)         AS checkout_open,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_registration = 1  AND f_login_success = 1)         AS registration_and_login_success,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_personalinfo = 1  AND f_personalinfo_continue = 1)  AS personalinfo_and_continue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_ident = 1         AND f_ident_submitted = 1)        AS ident_and_submitted,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_appointment = 1   AND f_appointment_submitted = 1)  AS appointment_and_submitted,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_shipping = 1      AND f_shipping_submitted = 1)     AS shipping_and_submitted,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_payment = 1       AND f_consent = 1)                AS payment_and_consent,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE f_consent = 1       AND f_order_placed = 1)           AS consent_and_orderplaced
    FROM base_flags
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    period,

    -- Step-own completion rate (pageview → completed that step)
    ROUND(1.0 * checkout_open                  / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3)                AS basket_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * registration_and_login_success / NULLIF(registration_page_optional, 0), 3) AS registration_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * personalinfo_and_continue      / NULLIF(personalinfo_page, 0), 3)          AS personalinfo_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * ident_and_submitted            / NULLIF(ident_page_optional, 0), 3)        AS identification_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * appointment_and_submitted      / NULLIF(appointment_page_optional, 0), 3)  AS appointment_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * shipping_and_submitted         / NULLIF(shipping_page, 0), 3)              AS shipping_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * payment_and_consent            / NULLIF(payment_page, 0), 3)               AS payment_conv,
    ROUND(1.0 * consent_and_orderplaced        / NULLIF(orderreview_page, 0), 3)           AS consent_conv,

    -- Raw numerator counts (completed-step session counts)
    checkout_open                     AS basket_conv_vol,
    registration_and_login_success    AS registration_conv_vol,
    personalinfo_and_continue         AS personalinfo_conv_vol,
    ident_and_submitted               AS identification_conv_vol,
    appointment_and_submitted         AS appointment_conv_vol,
    shipping_and_submitted            AS shipping_conv_vol,
    payment_and_consent               AS payment_conv_vol,
    consent_and_orderplaced           AS consent_conv_vol

FROM base2
ORDER BY period_sort DESC;
